title: Class-II sharp-cube source-square reduction
statement: For the hash-pinned A1 production coefficients and the A7-A11 strict sharp rectangular-cube filtration, the adapted source satisfies sum_j ||G_j^* B(P_<=j-1 phi) D P_<=j-1 phi||_2^2 <= C_src ||phi||_6^6, where C_src=(beta_op^2/c_sym) M_R^2 M_6^4 Q_6^2. The separated production-budget route is exactly ruled out: M_6>=8, Q_6>=8 sqrt(3), and H_6=M_6^4 Q_6^2>=786432, while the source-only target is H_6<29.62571266025876. A13 subsequently restores exact B and the output shell but closes the standalone source/sextic allocation negatively with an internal SU(2) relative-phase carrier; it does not prove the exact source constant infinite.
scope: PROVED-ANALYTIC-REDUCTION-AND-SCALAR-BUDGET-NOGO@FIXED-FLOOR-SHARP-CUBE on L=16 for the A1 production coefficients, three complex components in the six-real convention, rho_regularizer=1e-12, a common real-even scalar regulator with supremum M_R, and the strict sharp rectangular-cube dyadic filtration. The original cutoff-uniform reduction remains valid. T-047 is closed negatively by the exact Riesz boundary-modulation lower bound and an independent finite rational countercertificate. A13 closes T-049 negatively as a production-budget gate while leaving finiteness of the exact-B source constant unclassified; the surviving constructive route is a joint source-potential or redesigned-increment estimate.
